items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Some of the other guys old times played along with us since I've been playing with you all. Who are? I know Freddie on the tram horn.

ctx.x: Of course I can solo on but I make it better on that one. And I cut loose and they say go on here. I don't know if they're going to do that.

I don't think they're going to do that. Some of the other guys old times played along with us since I've been playing with you all. Who are? I know Freddie on the tram horn. He's one of the old times. Yeah. He rang the pretty got his horn.
